title: SAP Confirms Cyberattack, Source Code Reportedly Compromised
description: SAP confirmed a cybersecurity incident involving suspicious activity on its GitHub repositories. Attackers reportedly used stolen employee authentication tokens to copy and alter source code. SAP has implemented emergency security measures including replacing signing keys and limiting GitHub access. There is no evidence of unauthorized access to customer business data or that tampered code was incorporated into delivered software. The full extent of proprietary code exposure remains unclear, and AI involvement in the attack is unconfirmed.
